title: Harlequin config
description: A .harlequin.toml or harlequin.toml file, or the [tool.harlequin] table of a pyproject.toml. Read by both the harlequin IDE and the hsql command.

default_profile.description: The profile both commands load when -P/--profile does not name one.

profiles.description: Named sets of options, one table each. -P NAME loads one; the profile named None is Harlequin's own defaults.

keymaps.description: Named key bindings for the harlequin IDE, one array of bindings each.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: A profile's options: the ones each command reads for itself, plus the connection options declared by the adapter it names.

conn_str.description: What to connect to, which both commands take positionally. One string, or an array of them for an adapter that takes several.

file.description: Execute SQL from a file, or from stdin for `-`. Repeatable.

output.description: Write results to PATH instead of stdout. Accepts a file or directory.

format.description: Output format. See below for the list.

vertical.description: Shorthand for --format vertical. As in psql.

tuples_only.description: Rows only: no header, no footer. As in psql.

no_header.description: Omit the header row, keeping other chrome.

no_footer.description: Omit the row-count footer, keeping other chrome.

null_string.description: Render NULL as TEXT. Defaults to NULL for text formats, empty for csv.

profile.description: Select a profile from an available config file to load its values. Other options passed here will take precedence over those loaded from the profile. Use the special profile named None to use Harlequin's defaults, instead of the default profile specified in the config file.

adapter.description: The name of an installed database adapter plug-in to use to connect to the database at CONN_STR.

read_only.description: Connect read-only, and refuse to run at all if the adapter cannot. To check an adapter's capabilities, use --info.

timeout.description: Cancel the run after SECONDS and exit 4. Refused if the adapter cannot cancel a query; to check, use --info.

ssh_host.description: Open an SSH tunnel to this destination first, and connect through it. A Host alias, host, user@host or ssh://user@host:port, passed to ssh verbatim.

ssh_forward.description: A local forward, spelled as ssh -L takes one: LOCAL:HOST:REMOTE. Repeat this option for more than one. Omit it when your ssh config already has the LocalForward.

ssh_batch_mode.description: Fail rather than prompt for a passphrase, a password or a host key. ssh's own BatchMode.

ssh_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the tunnel's forwards. Default is 60.

config_path.description: By default, Harlequin finds files named .harlequin.toml in the current directory and the home directory (~) and merges them. Use this option to specify the full path to a config file at a different location.

config_mode.description: Report on the config files hsql found, or write a profile into one, and exit without running SQL. One of: show, list-profiles, validate, schema, init.

catalog.description: List the catalog objects one level below --path, and exit without running SQL.

catalog_search.description: Search the whole catalog, at every level, for objects whose name contains TERM, and exit without running SQL. Not every adapter can; see --info.

path.description: Where in the catalog --catalog looks, and what --catalog-search searches under. Dotted segments, named by the adapter; the top of the catalog by default. A trailing * filters a --catalog listing.

history.description: List the queries harlequin and hsql have run, newest first, and exit without running SQL. --limit says how many; -P, -a or a CONN_STR narrows it to one database.

history_search.description: List the logged queries whose SQL contains TERM, newest first, and exit without running SQL. Scoped like --history.

spec.description: Every option here, plus every installed adapter's, as JSON. -a narrows it to one adapter.

info.description: Versions, config files, the active profile, and what each installed adapter declares it supports, as JSON. Connects to nothing. -a narrows it to one adapter.

skill.description: Write the Agent Skill for driving hsql, as markdown. -o installs it: 'hsql --skill -o ~/.claude/skills/hsql/'.

session_reset.description: Ask the session to close its connection and open a fresh one, and exit without running SQL. Temp tables, settings and an open transaction are gone. Needs --session.

queue_timeout.description: With --serve: a request waits at most SECONDS for the one before it, then exits 4 without reaching the database. [default: no limit]

idle_timeout.description: With --serve: stop the session once it has gone SECONDS with no request. 0 for a session that waits as long as it takes.

max_lifetime.description: With --serve: stop the session SECONDS after it connected, whatever it is doing; a request already running finishes first. 0 for a session that runs until something stops it.

limit.description: Maximum rows fetched per result set. -1 for no limit.

display_rows.description: Rows printed per result set by the text layouts. -1 for all rows. [default: 40 for table, markdown, md; 10 for vertical]

on_error.description: What to do when a statement fails.

no_write_history.description: Do not record this run's queries in the query history that Harlequin and hsql share.

stats.description: Write a one-line JSON summary to stderr.

color.description: Color text output. `auto` follows the terminal and NO_COLOR.

theme.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

viewer_max_rows.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

show_files.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

show_s3.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

keymap_name.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

locale.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

no_download_tzdata.description: Read by the harlequin IDE; hsql ignores it. See `harlequin --help`.

keybinding.title: Key binding
keybinding.description: One key binding: the keys, the action they run, and how to show them.
